source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the divisions and names read from the Derry Journal's Strabane Rural Council nominations (6 May 1936, p. 8) and checked against the Belfast Telegraph's list of the same date (p. 3)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by the clerk, Mr. J. L. Rankin, on 5 May 1936. No division was contested; all the nominees were returned unopposed. Polling in County Tyrone was fixed for Wednesday 3 June 1936 (Strabane Chronicle, 21 March 1936, p. 4; Belfast News-Letter, 17 March 1936, p. 12); no poll was needed where all seats were filled at nominations. Filed on 1936-06-03, the Tyrone polling day (previously filed under 1936-05-28, 6 Nov 2026). Dick, J.P. Returned unopposed.
